scope: original approval concept artwork; no game integration or push

traits.name: Twin Leader
traits.biological_basis: Bifurcation or spontaneous loss of apical dominance
traits.evidence: Game label; firsthand visual reports, cause unconfirmed
traits.research_note: Two leaders may follow spontaneous developmental change or injury. A Y-shaped fork does not prove a heritable mutation.
traits.art_direction: One rooted trunk should visibly divide into two comparable upright leaders. Keep the fork clear through the foliage and give each leader its own terminal flower.
traits.avoid: Two separate seedlings, two disconnected trunks, or a single unchanged central cola. Calling a trained plant proof of a genetic mutation.
traits.stage_notes: Young: one trunk before division. Vegetative: readable Y fork. Flowering: two separated leading colas.

traits.name: Crested Cola
traits.evidence: Documented growth abnormality; stem and flower references
traits.research_note: Fasciation flattens and broadens growth; its causes vary. A crest alone does not demonstrate polyploidy.
traits.art_direction: Show a ribbon-like upper stem supporting a broad, scalloped fan or elongated crest of flower tissue. Use lateral width, not just additional height.
traits.avoid: An ordinary round bud enlarged uniformly. Three separate leaders used as a substitute for a fused crest.
traits.stage_notes: Young: optional broadening at the tip. Vegetative: flatten the affected stem. Flowering: make the crest unmistakable from its outline.

traits.name: Triple Whorl
traits.biological_basis: Whorled phyllotaxy with three organs per node
traits.evidence: Documented visible arrangement; distinct from triploidy
traits.research_note: Three leaves around one node are a phyllotaxy pattern, not evidence of three chromosome sets.
traits.art_direction: Place three petioles or branches at the same stem level, spaced around the axis. In an oblique view, allow a smaller rear leaf to remain visible.
traits.avoid: Three leaflets on one leaf; ordinary opposite pairs; automatically assigning the Triploid identity.
traits.stage_notes: Young: show the three-way arrangement clearly. Vegetative: repeat on selected nodes. Flowering: keep three-way branch origins visible. Persistence can vary.

traits.name: Pocket Dwarf
traits.evidence: Game name; compact cultivar and anecdotal dwarf analogues
traits.research_note: Lowryder offers a compact plant reference. Small stature alone does not prove a particular dwarf mutation.
traits.art_direction: Shorten the stem gaps between nodes and the branch reach while preserving full leaf shapes. Include the same pot or a scale marker for comparison.
traits.avoid: A tall sparse plant labeled dwarf. Simply scaling the entire normal plant down, including all leaf detail, with no structural difference.
traits.stage_notes: Young: size may be ambiguous. Vegetative: compressed node spacing. Flowering: short mature silhouette with flowers close to the main stem.

traits.name: Triploid
traits.biological_basis: Three chromosome sets, commonly 30 chromosomes in cannabis
traits.evidence: Confirmed cytogenetic trait; scientific comparison photographs
traits.research_note: Triploidy concerns chromosome number. Published diploid/triploid comparisons do not supply a universal identifying silhouette.
traits.art_direction: Keep believable cannabis architecture. If needed for gameplay, add a clearly designed UI badge or subtle vigor cue, explicitly marked as a game convention.
traits.avoid: Three leaves per node, a crest, or guaranteed giant buds used as visual proof. Universal yield or potency promises.
traits.stage_notes: All stages: identity comes from the game’s genetic state. Show ordinary growth; consult the comparison figure for variation, not a diagnostic rule.

identity_limits: Triploid is a genetic identity, not a guaranteed silhouette, vigor, bud size, whorled node or fasciated crest. 3x copper badge is a proposed game UI convention. Bifurcation, fasciation and dwarf stature do not establish a heritable mutation from photographs alone.
source_handling: Originals unmodified outside repository; supplied provenance retained; no source photograph shipped as game art.
approval_note: User called the concepts perfect and authorized implementing one mutation at a time. Runtime work is reviewed separately.
